returnInterest.note: I would really like to return; preferably for a road trip, and explore the nature and landscapes of Norway.

description.intro: Norway is a Scandinavian country known for its dramatic fjords, mountains, and northern landscapes. I have not explored much of the country yet, so it is hard for me to judge it as a whole. Despite being sick for the entire trip and arriving sleep deprived after a night bus from Stockholm to Oslo, I still came away with a very positive impression.
standouts: Modern architecture mixed with historic areas.
Sunny winter weather made the cold feel manageable.
personalNotes: I was sick and sleep deprived for the entire time I was in Norway, so I didn't get to enjoy it as much as I wanted to.

travelPracticalities.visaNotes: I did not need a visa.
paymentNotes: Card was the most commonly used payment method.
I believe most places also accepted cash.
transportNotes: Norway has quite an extensive train network.
languageNotes: The official languages are Norwegian and Sami.
Norwegian has two offical written forms: Bokmål and Nynorsk.
Sami is a Uralic language spoken by small groups of indiginous people in the north of the country.
Although Sami is counted as one language there are actually several different Sami languages, which are not mutually intelligible and around 4 of them are spoken in Norway.
English was widely spoken and communication was very easy.

notes: It was not extremely cold because I got lucky with a lot of sunshine.

regionsOverview.name: Oslo
notes: I enjoyed Oslo much more than I expected.
The city felt relaxed and modern.
It was quite walkable and felt smaller than its actual size.
